initiative.title: Composed analytical graphics
initiative.summary: Author polished report graphics from a blank page using primitives, repeated templates, scoped calculations, group placement, and instance overrides.

claims.statement: Users can make one coherent analytical graphic from several simple visual parts
source_anchors: dictation:single chart rather than panel charts

claims.statement: Define a small visual unit once and repeat it for selected groups
Global title, subtitle, guides, and scales can frame repeated content
source_anchors: dictation:global items and global time scale

claims.statement: A selected mark or derived value reveals the data and calculation that produced it
source_anchors: dictation:click on a data point and see exactly how it got there

claims.statement: Users refine text, color, size, position, data bindings, and annotations with immediate visual feedback
source_anchors: dictation:control over text size selection color and annotations

claims.statement: Calculations can use repeated-subset or composition-wide populations, with an explicit policy for active filters
source_anchors: dictation:average line for each chart or global data

claims.statement: The email-strip graphic illustrates repeated rows with labels, totals, and a shared time scale
The EV price and range comparison illustrates coordinated panels, trend lines, and editorial text
A nested chart object or general visualization grammar might represent composed output
Some elements may support free placement or drag adjustment
claims.notes: Group placement and instance nudges are now explicit needs. Individual annotation dragging remains less specific.

claims.statement: Normal authoring should feel intuitive and should not require writing a chart specification
claims.notes: The product must support blank-page construction through visible primitive controls.

claims.statement: Current charts are separate registry components, while facets and tracing cover only parts of the desired composition
Composition mode produces durable polished graphics for reports and presentations
Authoring starts from a blank page where the user chooses primitives
Text, frames or scales, and data-bound mark definitions form a single template that repeats over subsets
Repeat layouts include comparison panels, stacked rows, and facet grids without decorative cards
An individual instance override combines with the original template to produce the final result
Calculations are usually created on the spot after applying the relevant filters or aggregation
Editing and viewing have distinct modes; editing clicks select and viewing clicks support drilldown
Alt-click may open full tracing in viewing mode
Automatic repeat placement combines with user placement of groups and instance nudges
The representative graphic uses about 10000 source rows, 10–15 repeated units, and 1000–2000 glyphs
Instance overrides attach to subset identity rather than display position
claims.notes: Agent recommendation; identity behavior has not yet been selected by the user.

claims.statement: PNG output with a Copy to clipboard action is sufficient initially
Initial instance overrides change position and visual properties
Repeated charts use common scales by default wherever possible
Annotations support data, frame, and page anchors; data-bound annotations can follow moving marks
Recurring reports and parameterized dashboards belong to a separate project and are outside the current scope

human_questions.question: Which report export format and degree of PowerPoint editability are required?
human_questions.resolution: PNG and Copy to clipboard are sufficient initially.

human_questions.question: How far can an individual instance override alter its appearance, data binding, or calculation?
human_questions.resolution: Position and visual details only initially.

human_questions.question: Which scale defaults and annotation anchors are needed, and should a saved composition accept replacement data for recurring reports?
human_questions.resolution: Common scales by default; data, frame, and page anchors; recurring reports outside scope.

shape.appetite: One complete authoring and output flow plus a small layout check; five staged capability extensions
shape.problem: The workspace cannot author polished graphics from primitives, repeated units, scoped calculations, and individual refinements
shape.recommended_shape: Blank composition editor with repeated templates, common scales, visual instance overrides, group placement, three annotation anchor types, editing/viewing modes, and PNG clipboard output

first_proof.question: Can the author build and finish a repeated graphic from blank while keeping its inputs and exceptions understandable?
first_proof.artifact: A graphic authored from blank, saved and reloaded, with shared scales, visual overrides, scoped calculations, tracing, annotation anchors, and PNG clipboard output
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed when blank authoring, save/reload, correct tracing, visual override retention, anchor behavior, and pasted PNG appearance work; check a second repeat arrangement before widening mark coverage

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Detached HEAD; initiative documents are untracked; application code unchanged
